newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg estimates cut.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg analyst Chris Jakubik said he reduced his earnings estimates for Kellogg Co to $3.05 a share from $3.40 for 1996 and to $3.50 a share from $3.85 for 1997.
-- He reiterated his reduce rating on Kellogg.

-- On September 4, Kellogg said it expects earnings for the third quarter will be about 20 percent below the $1.05 a share it earned a year ago and full-year 1996 earnings will be below the $3.48 it earned in 1995.
-- Kellogg shares rose 1/4 at 66-1/4 in composite trading after hitting a new low earlier this morning of 65-5/8. Shares on the New York Stock Exchange dropped 2-3/8 at 66-1/8.
-- Kellogg said its third quarter performance was hurt by competitive promotion activity in the U.S. cereal category.
-- Jakubik said Kellogg likely will be forced to respond to the increased promotions by its competitors, General Mills Inc and the Post Cereal division of Philip Morris Cos Inc .
